title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1970-03-01
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
source: Recording Info: SBD Master Reels -> Dat (Panasonic 3700); Transfer Info: Delta DiO 2496 sound card > HD > CD-R; Mastering Info: HD > CD WAV > Cool Edit > Trader's Little Helper 2.7 > xACT 2.35 FLAC 8; Mastering by Seth Kaplan (alligator69@optonline.net) March 25, 2015

ai_review.summary: Great soundboard capture with brief cuts; a mellow set highlighted by standout Cumberland Blues and King Bee.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean sound‑board source that sounds great despite a few very short cuts, making it an enjoyable listen. Musically the night is modest – the band stays on the mellow side after feedback forces a volume dip during The Other One, but they deliver strong performances of Cumberland Blues and King Bee while some slower moments (Uncle John's Band) feel too drawn out.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is average to good with a few standout songs, while the recording is clear and well‑balanced; limited number of reviews yields moderate confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall great sound with brief cuts that are not disruptive; no major distortion or balance issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set stays relatively mellow after feedback forces a volume reduction during The Other One; experimental down‑tempo on Uncle John's Band slows the momentum, but strong bluesy numbers keep interest.
